why: 命令行工具的输出格式和退出码是外部可观察的契约，应当逐条成为验收条件。
title: --json output for the CLI
description: Add a --json flag to `km status`. With it the command prints one JSON object with exactly the keys name, version, healthy (boolean) and checked_at (ISO 8601), and nothing else on stdout. Unknown flags exit with code 2 and print usage to stderr. Without --json the human-readable output stays as it is.
